title: The Initial plan for the school
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：initial　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 initial 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the writer wrote of ① an initial plan for the school in the manuscript, and everybody in the study said at once that it was ② so initial that nobody in the study would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the writer, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the initial ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the initial plan for the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manuscript for January 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too initial to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the reader who had come to help; the initial ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an initial letter of the name, and said that no reader in his right mind would call it ⑥ as initial as the letter of the name they had once had in the old study. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was initial or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript. What the line asked for was ⑦ something initial, and nothing besides. The reader from the next study called the whole plan ⑧ quite initial; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the manuscript kept the names of the initial ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, at once, she wrote of another initial plan for the school in the same manuscript, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less initial than anybody had expected. ⑩ The initial letter of the name that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the initial ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 最初（前置定语 an initial plan for the school：1980 年写作者在手稿里记下的那件最初的方案）
B. adj. 最初／开头（两处加强说法：so initial that … 与 no less initial than …）
C. adj. 最初／开头（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 最初（表语 too initial to do：母亲觉得它太最初，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 开头（前置定语 an initial letter of the name：叔叔把整件事称作一桩开头的首字母）
F. adj. 开头（同级比较 as initial as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩名字的首字母相比）
G. adj. 开头（后置定语 something initial：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 开头（受程度副词修饰 quite initial：那位读者的评价）

items.q: an initial plan for the school
the initial plan for the school that
an initial letter of the name
The initial letter of the name that

answers.why: initial 意为“最初”，1980 年写作者在手稿里记下的是“一件最初的方案”，此处作前置定语 an initial plan for the school。
initial 意为“最初”，此处用 so initial that 结构，说它最初到书斋里没人敢靠近。
initial 意为“最初”，手稿上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的最初学校最初的方案，等于最高级的说法。
initial 意为“最初”，母亲认为这件东西“太最初了，谁也用不上”，too initial to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
initial 意为“开头”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩开头的首字母”，此处作前置定语 an initial letter of the name。
initial 意为“开头”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩名字的首字母一样开头”，同级比较用 as initial as。
initial 意为“开头”，手稿上那半行字要的是“开头的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something initial。
initial 意为“开头”，邻书斋来的那位读者认为这套计划“相当开头”，quite 修饰原级 initial。
initial 意为“开头”，no less initial than 表示“其开头不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之开头不亚于任何人的预料。
initial 意为“开头”，母亲 1992 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的开头首字母”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，写作者在手稿里记下了一件最初的方案。（an initial plan for the school）
它最初到书斋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so initial that …）
母亲觉得它太最初，谁也用不上。（too initial to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩开头的首字母。（an initial letter of the name）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩名字的首字母一样开头。（as initial as …）
到了 1987 年，手稿上只剩半行字：要的是一件开头的东西。（something initial）
answers: In 1980 the writer wrote of an initial plan for the school in the manuscript.
It was so initial that nobody in the study would go near it.
My mother thought it too initial to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an initial letter of the name.
He said nobody would call it as initial as the letter of the name they had once had.
By 1987 the manuscript asked for nothing but something initial.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 initial 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the writer wrote of an initial plan for the school in the manuscript, and nobody forgot it.
It was the initial plan for the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the manuscript says.
My mother thought it too initial to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an initial letter of the name, and nobody argued with him.
The reader from the next study called the plan quite initial, and everybody laughed.
The initial ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
